capabilities: Break down vault storage by category
List and sort files by size, name, or mtime
disambiguation: Not a general file manager; plugin data, config, and hidden-path categories are read-only with no delete entry.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or higher. No search, no undo for restore, empty-folder deletion, or emptying .trash; the 10 MB large-file threshold and scan scope are not configurable, and results only refresh on manual rescan.
problem: Obsidian shows no breakdown of which files or categories use vault storage, so finding and removing large or empty files means manual searching.
summary: Storage viewer and cleanup tool that breaks vault storage into categories and cleans large files, empty files, and the .trash folder.
